primary: Exploration primary: all externally arrived requests mean completion flow; failures and unfinished cannot be omitted or treated as success. Complete output rate, TTFT, per-request maximum generation gaps, final drain and individual harms are required side effects. Tradeoffs allowed; no post-hoc SLO or significance claim.

hypothesis: A complete simple largest-declared-remaining-budget victim baseline may preserve bounded short jobs until completion, reducing all-arrival mean flow. Less immediate release can instead cause extra victims and repeated recovery and erase that value.
claim_ceiling: Exploratory full-strategy ABBA of an existing remaining-work scheduling principle, with declared generation caps as the available upper-bound proxy. Not a new method, full CacheOPT reproduction, equal-capacity comparison, predicted EOS, same-hidden-state causal replay or independent confirmation.
retention: All cells and failures retained; at most this one ABBA. No threshold, trigger-position, sharing, arrival or capacity scans. Zero action permits only a bounded entry/opportunity diagnosis; no repeated same-domain search.

diagnostic_question: Does complete native-legal remaining-budget victim ordering improve all-arrival mean completion flow once lower released capacity, any additional victims, native recovery and individual harms are counted?
decision_rule: Zero actual choices: bounded entry diagnosis only, no same-domain matrix. Executed choices without support for the frozen primary: stop this budget proxy in this domain, no threshold rescue or added predictor. Uncertain within this one-group limit stays unresolved; no automatic repeat to significance. Supported mean-flow benefit first belongs to the ordinary simple baseline; next test max actual-release and inspect residual loss before claiming an added contribution. Disclose all throughput/TTFT/gap/per-request harms; not every metric must improve.

runtime_scope: Only native allocation-failure victim selection differs. At every decision choose largest declared max_tokens-output_tokens over the entire existing legal unprocessed suffix, latest index on ties. Current/self, partial-prefill, zero-output, shared and pending-store requests remain eligible if native-legal. Active phase/protection or unknown/invalid cap or output returns tail. Physical release, computed pages, host state, old qualified/fallback_unknown and pending metadata do not qualify/rank. The native loop itself performs all retries/free/preempt. Other Q1/target/1s-trigger/quantum/transfer/admission and all observations remain fixed.
